Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the search results and incorrectly asserted that Wikipedia (and Deutsche Biographie) listed Paris as André Beaunier’s birthplace. In reality, sources shown (Wikipedia, Dreyfus dictionary, Deutsche Biographie) indicated Évreux. This error stemmed from relying on SERP snippets without verifying the linked pages and failing to cross-check authoritative sources, causing the workflow to pursue the wrong birthplace.
